title: Chinese AI Models Hit 61% Market Share On OpenRouter
abstract_or_snippet: Reports Chinese-origin models reaching a majority of OpenRouter token volume in early 2026, up from <2% a year prior. Media restatement of OpenRouter data — NOT a primary number.
gate_reason: access_status:content_mismatch (decision-procedure step 3).
